name: Amime Takezaiku
description: Amime Takezaiku — a WooCommerce store theme for a bamboo basket workshop in a mountain valley, laid out as horizontal strips you read from left to right. A formal white top header carries the shop name, the Shop the baskets button, account and cart; from 1100 px the main menu stands as a fixed sumi side rail on the left (vertical entries in Chinese and Japanese), below that it opens from a Menu button as a full-screen kariyasu overlay. Kariyasu yellow (#F5E56B) is the main colour: the hero field, the shelf band, the grove card, every page head and the footer strip are kariyasu fields with sumi olive-black text, and woven bamboo textures (ajiro twill and kagome hexagon, raster watercolour) run through them. The hero sets the shop line on the left and a framed watercolour of the bamboo grove on the right; a cut-out round basket (transparent WebP) breaks out over the frame and the hero's bottom edge. The workshop board is one horizontal strip, the five steps from grove to basket stand side by side on one long bamboo strip, the baskets line up on a shelf that scrolls sideways, and a full-bleed grove panorama carries a kariyasu card that a cut-out flower basket breaks out of. Every picture is a soft watercolour illustration. Sawarabi Mincho for display, Urbanist for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-13 (horizontal-strip, text-left-art-right hero, side-rail nav, pattern-texture, watercolour, kariyasu #F5E56B, Sawarabi Mincho + Urbanist, bamboo basketry in crafts-homeware). A formal white top header: the shop name on the left; the Shop the baskets button, account and cart on the right. Side rail: from 1100 px the main menu stands as a fixed sumi rail down the left edge below the header, numbered entries (vertical entries in Chinese and Japanese) with a woven kariyasu edge; below 1100 px it opens from a Menu button as a full-screen kariyasu overlay. Horizontal strip: the home page reads as horizontal bands; the workshop board is one strip of five cells, the five steps from grove to basket stand side by side on one long bamboo strip, the baskets line up on a shelf that scrolls sideways, the grove is one wide panorama strip and the notes are one row each. Text left, art right: the shop line, lead and buttons on the left of the kariyasu hero, a framed watercolour of the bamboo grove on the right. Pattern texture: raster watercolour ajiro twill and kagome hexagon weaves run through the hero, the side rail edge, the step strip, the shelf band, page heads and the footer strip. Watercolour: every picture is a soft watercolour illustration (Grok Build). Break-frame: the cut-out round basket (transparent WebP) breaks out over the hero frame and over the hero bottom edge into the board; the cut-out flower basket breaks out of the kariyasu card over the top edge of the grove band; the basket also breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: sumi olive-black #22200F on kariyasu #F5E56B 12.7:1 (all text on the hero field, the shelf band, page heads, the board lead cell, the band card and the footer strip; the woven textures multiplied in only darken the field slightly); ink on kariyasu washi #FFFCEB 15.9:1, on white 16.4:1 and on pale kariyasu #FAF3C4 14.6:1; deep olive #5F5410 on washi 7.4:1, on white 7.6:1 and on kariyasu 5.9:1 (links, prices, labels; white on deep 7.6:1); quiet olive grey #5A5644 on washi 7.2:1 (secondary text); pale kariyasu #F9EFA0 on ink 14.0:1 and kariyasu on ink 12.7:1 (side rail numbers, buttons, chips, footer); bamboo green #4F6B2E on washi 5.9:1 (small dots only); white on kariyasu only 1.3:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 刈安黃的竹編工房商店：側邊選單、橫向條帶版面，左文右圖的水彩竹林，去背竹籃破框而出；含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A kariyasu-yellow bamboo basket store in horizontal strips, with a side-rail menu, a watercolour grove and a cut-out basket breaking out.
summary.ja: 刈安色の竹細工のお店。サイドレールのメニューと横に流れる帯の構成、水彩の竹林から切り抜きのかごが枠を破ります。五か国語つき。
summary.fr: Une boutique de vannerie jaune kariyasu en bandes horizontales, menu latéral, bois aquarellé et panier détouré hors du cadre.
summary.de: Ein kariyasu-gelber Bambuskorbladen in waagrechten Streifen, mit Seitenleiste, Aquarellhain und freigestelltem Korb, der ausbricht.
